Keep public imports on the @radesign/kit barrel contract.
Run npm run validate:feedback and npm run validate after applying the patch.

The 403 numeral is decorative while the heading and description provide the full accessible meaning.
Recovery actions let the user return or request access without exposing unauthorized operations.
DOM, harness, browser, package, and bundle validation stay green.
